title: Hometown Breeze

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered pastoral ensemble with a fitted corset-style bodice, a pleated apron over a voluminous tiered skirt, and puffed sleeves, creating a balanced, rustic, and charming couture silhouette with a relaxed, airy volume.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A woven harvest crown of dried wheat, red roses, and green foliage, with a thin braided cord and a subtle ribbon trailing from the back, evoking a rustic pastoral charm.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A structured, ribbed wool bodice in warm amber, featuring a square neckline with ornate gold braid trim and central diamond-shaped embroidery, paired with sheer white cotton puffed sleeves with lace cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A layered skirt featuring a cream pleated apron with floral embroidery and a lace hem, over a rust-orange tiered skirt adorned with wheat motifs, completed with a small embroidered pouch and simple rustic shoes.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A small embroidered harvest pouch at the waist, woven wheat motifs, and floating autumn leaves, bringing a nostalgic, rural field atmosphere to the design.
